title: Compute relative Josephson current vs normalized frequency
action: Implement the theoretical model for coupled electroacoustic oscillations in a long Josephson junction, yielding a dispersion relation and an expression for the uniform (dc) Josephson current. Using the electromechanical coupling constant δ=2.5×10⁻⁷, normalized damping Γ̄/Ωn=0.03, and imaginary-to-real wave-number ratio Im k/Re k=10⁻⁶, compute the normalized current j0/j̃0 as a function of normalized frequency ω/Ωn over the interval 0.5 to 5.0 with at least 100 equally spaced points. Write the result to the output CSV.
description: The agent computes the normalized Josephson current by evaluating the analytical model for coupled electroacoustic waves and the dc Josephson current expression, derived from the Josephson relations and piezoelectric coupling. The output CSV quantifies the relative current as a function of normalized frequency, which will be checked for the predicted bump structure.
output_schema: Two columns: 'omega_over_Omega_n' (float, dimensionless ω/Ωn) and 'relative_current' (float, dimensionless j0/j̃0). At least 100 rows covering [0.5, 5.0].
